integrity.computational_support: 16 exact finite integer-programming comparisons; not a proof of the general theorem
integrity.method: Symbolic injection and canonical replacement followed by matching pair-packing construction
integrity.proof_scope: All integer q,n >= 2; explicit standard-design corollaries for n=3

scientific_limitations: The general parameter P(q,n,2) remains a possibly difficult independent block-packing optimization; the result is an exact reduction, not a closed integer formula for arbitrary block size.
The explicit residue-class evaluation is for n=3; no classification of all original optimal multisets or efficient encoder is claimed.
An independent mathematical audit and exhaustive worldwide priority certification have not been performed.
title: Exact reduction of two-survivor multiset deletion codes to pair packings
